silent_on: how to recognise AdaptiveDesign's ok lines inside ConfigMe's doctor output
chose: Run the AD clone's install.sh --check on the same home. A line starting with ok or bad gives a message (to its first tab). Each ok message must be in an ok-helper (*) line of the doctor's claude section; each bad-helper (x) line there must be one of AD's bad messages.

silent_on: what 'exit status as for any other failed feature' is in install mode
chose: 0, as when the nvim download or the rustup install fails. Also asserted: a bad-helper line naming the path and a fix: line in the claude section, then ==> features, ==> packages and Done.

silent_on: which AdaptiveDesign the tests install from
chose: A clone of CONFIGME_TEST_AD_SOURCE (default: AdaptiveDesign beside the main checkout) at that checkout's HEAD commit, copied per case. CONFIGME_NO_CLONE=1 always, so M1's clone from GitHub is never exercised.

silent_on: how far to isolate the installer beyond HOME
chose: env -i: HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, CONFIGME_FEATURES, ADAPTIVE_DESIGN_DIR, CONFIGME_NO_CLONE, TERM, LANG, and PATH minus real-home entries. Shims: systemctl no-op, gh auth status succeeds; curl, wget, sudo, other gh and git clone of a URL fail. ~/.tmux/plugins/tpm pre-made.

silent_on: installed paths that contain the patterns: ~/.claude/skills, ~/.claude/rules, ~/.local/bin/claude-*, AdaptiveDesign's core/bin/claude-*
chose: Those four forms are not dangling and are skipped. Any other occurrence in a tracked file outside the three exempt files fails.

silent_on: tracked or present files, and where the core/bin names come from
chose: Tracked files only (git ls-files). The names are read from the AD clone's core/bin, so the case fails until AdaptiveDesign has core/bin.

silent_on: install.sh's exit status where the case does not name one

silent_on: whether 'as milestone T in AdaptiveDesign' includes AD's E trailer
chose: No trailer: the E rule covers contributions to AdaptiveDesign from other repos, and ConfigMe's milestones are done from ConfigMe.

what: The AGENTS.md template points at docs/MILESTONES.md 'Merging', a format command and a status table; this frame has none of them, so those were rewrites rather than slot fills. The template could mark them as optional.

'In the same form' as AdaptiveDesign's scripts/test, which another agent is writing at the same time: the form came from AD's DESIGN.md 'Tests' alone, so the two runners may differ in detail (exit cap, single-case runs).

The template's [check] detail = '^FAIL|^  ' matches every indented line, and scripts/check's detail_lines also adds the line after each match, so each detail line printed twice and the 40-line cap filled with installer output. Changed to '^FAIL '; the template default has the same flaw.
